body:
In the menu bar at the top of every page, the **Delivery** button moves from its current place (after Strategy) to sit between **Contracts** and **Knowledgebase**. The other buttons keep their order.

---
For the agent: reorder the `link` list in `frontend.view` (solace-cli/frontend). Update the page list in `knowledgebase.sections` that names the menu's pages in order, and any test that checks the menu order.
title: menu: Delivery between Contracts and Knowledgebase
